title: hf session via meta git worktree + policy.toml + sync preflight
objective: ADR-0001 §2: add `hf session start|end [--recycle]` using `meta git worktree create|remove|prune` (NOT raw git worktree) off origin/<base_branch>, reserve a weave path-scope lease, emit session_start/session_end; recycle a fresh set on end. Add `.handoff/policy.toml` (remote/loop/merge). MUST include a start-time preflight that verifies tree/branch/remote are in sync and refuses on drift (lesson from the prior weave loop failure). Depend only on the current lease-capable weave; refuse legacy repowire/mcp-broker.
acceptance_criteria: hf session via meta git worktree + policy.toml + sync preflight: implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
